scope: Expanded curated foundational library across disciplines. It is not exhaustive; entries are machine-readable reference knowledge, not automatically executable models or proof of empirical validity. Bibliographic review and application-specific verification remain required.

entries.title: Linear equation
entries.units_or_output: x = -b/a
entries.meaning: Solve for x when a is nonzero.
entries.epistemic_status: Exact algebraic identity
entries.limitations: Symbolic; numeric values require units if representing physical quantities.

entries.title: Quadratic equation
entries.units_or_output: x = (-b ± sqrt(b^2 - 4ac))/(2a)
entries.meaning: Roots depend on the discriminant and the number system.
entries.epistemic_status: Exact algebraic identity
entries.limitations: Numerical implementations should handle near-zero discriminants carefully.

entries.title: Derivative definition
entries.units_or_output: Limit, when it exists
entries.meaning: Local rate of change of a function.
entries.epistemic_status: Definition
entries.applicability_conditions: Limit exists
entries.limitations: A numerical finite difference is an approximation, not the definition itself.

entries.title: Definite integral
entries.units_or_output: Accumulated signed quantity
entries.meaning: Integral interpretation depends on the function and measure.
entries.epistemic_status: Definition
entries.applicability_conditions: Integrability conditions apply
entries.limitations: Numerical quadrature introduces discretization error.

entries.title: Ordinary differential equation
entries.units_or_output: Initial-value or boundary-value problem
entries.meaning: Represents evolving state under a specified dynamical law.
entries.epistemic_status: Model class
entries.applicability_conditions: Initial/boundary conditions and well-posedness required
entries.limitations: A solver cannot compensate for an invalid model or missing parameters.

entries.title: Bayes theorem
entries.units_or_output: Posterior from prior and likelihood
entries.meaning: Updates belief in a hypothesis using observed data.
entries.epistemic_status: Exact probability identity
entries.limitations: Results depend on the model, prior and data quality.

entries.title: Least squares
entries.units_or_output: Optimization objective
entries.meaning: Fits model parameters by minimizing squared residuals.
entries.epistemic_status: Standard method
entries.applicability_conditions: Objective and parameters must be defined
entries.limitations: Outliers and model misspecification can distort fits.

entries.title: Shannon entropy
entries.units_or_output: bits
entries.meaning: Measures uncertainty of a discrete probability distribution.
entries.epistemic_status: Definition
entries.applicability_conditions: pᵢ ≥ 0 and Σpᵢ=1
entries.limitations: Continuous differential entropy is a different quantity.

entries.title: Newton second law
entries.units_or_output: Net force equals mass times acceleration
entries.meaning: Classical mechanics relation for inertial frames and appropriate mass assumptions.
entries.epistemic_status: Established physical law
entries.applicability_conditions: Classical regime; consistent units
entries.limitations: Relativistic or quantum regimes require other formulations.

entries.title: Kinetic energy
entries.units_or_output: joules
entries.meaning: Translational kinetic energy in the non-relativistic regime.
entries.epistemic_status: Established equation
entries.applicability_conditions: m ≥ 0; v much less than speed of light
entries.limitations: Not the relativistic energy formula.

entries.title: Ideal gas law
entries.units_or_output: Pa·m³ = mol·J·mol⁻¹·K⁻¹
entries.meaning: Relates pressure, volume, amount and temperature for an ideal gas.
entries.epistemic_status: Approximation
entries.applicability_conditions: Absolute temperature; ideal-gas regime
entries.limitations: Real gases can deviate, especially at high pressure/low temperature.

entries.title: Heat equation
entries.units_or_output: temperature field over time
entries.meaning: Diffusion model for heat conduction under simplified material assumptions.
entries.epistemic_status: Model equation
entries.applicability_conditions: α > 0 and boundary/initial conditions
entries.limitations: Properties and geometry may vary; interfaces and convection need extra terms.

entries.title: Wave equation
entries.units_or_output: wave field
entries.meaning: Idealized propagation model.
entries.epistemic_status: Model equation
entries.applicability_conditions: c > 0 and boundary/initial conditions
entries.limitations: Medium dispersion, damping and nonlinear effects may be absent.

entries.title: Fick first law
entries.units_or_output: flux density
entries.meaning: Diffusive flux down a concentration gradient in a simple isotropic medium.
entries.epistemic_status: Established constitutive law
entries.applicability_conditions: D > 0 in the model
entries.limitations: Complex media may require anisotropic or non-Fickian models.

entries.title: Law of mass action
entries.formula_or_rule: For aA+bB ⇌ cC+dD: K = a_C^c a_D^d/(a_A^a a_B^b)
entries.units_or_output: dimensionless when activities are defined conventionally
entries.meaning: Equilibrium relation in terms of activities.
entries.epistemic_status: Established thermodynamic relation
entries.applicability_conditions: Specified reaction and standard states
entries.limitations: Concentration-only approximations may fail for non-ideal systems.

entries.title: pH definition
entries.units_or_output: dimensionless
entries.meaning: pH is defined through hydrogen-ion activity.
entries.epistemic_status: Definition
entries.applicability_conditions: Activity convention and measurement conditions specified
entries.limitations: Using concentration directly is an approximation in non-ideal solutions.

entries.title: Arrhenius equation
entries.units_or_output: rate constant depends on reaction order/units
entries.meaning: Empirical temperature dependence of many rate constants.
entries.epistemic_status: Empirical model
entries.applicability_conditions: T > 0 K; parameters calibrated for reaction
entries.limitations: Mechanistic changes can invalidate extrapolation.

entries.title: Stoichiometric balance
entries.formula_or_rule: Σ reactant atoms = Σ product atoms for each element
entries.units_or_output: elemental conservation
entries.meaning: Chemical equations must conserve each element and charge where applicable.
entries.epistemic_status: Conservation constraint
entries.applicability_conditions: Correct species and charges specified
entries.limitations: Does not by itself predict reaction rates or equilibrium.

entries.title: Michaelis–Menten kinetics
entries.units_or_output: rate units follow Vmax
entries.meaning: Classical enzyme rate approximation.
entries.epistemic_status: Approximate kinetic model
entries.applicability_conditions: Steady-state approximation and suitable substrate/enzyme conditions
entries.limitations: Not universal; inhibition, cooperativity and mechanisms can require other models.

entries.title: Logistic growth
entries.units_or_output: population per time
entries.meaning: Growth with a fixed carrying capacity.
entries.epistemic_status: Simplified model
entries.limitations: Assumes constant carrying capacity and ignores age/space structure.

entries.title: SIR epidemic model
entries.units_or_output: population compartments
entries.meaning: Simplified susceptible-infected-removed dynamics.
entries.epistemic_status: Simplified compartment model
entries.applicability_conditions: Nonnegative compartments and explicit epidemiological assumptions
entries.limitations: Not for clinical or public-health decisions without calibration and validation.

entries.title: Exponential growth
entries.units_or_output: population
entries.meaning: Growth or decay at a constant per-capita rate.
entries.epistemic_status: Simplified model
entries.applicability_conditions: Constant r
entries.limitations: Unbounded growth is unrealistic for many long-term populations.

entries.title: Diagnostic predictive value
entries.units_or_output: probability
entries.meaning: Shows how prevalence affects positive predictive value.
entries.epistemic_status: Probability identity under definitions
entries.applicability_conditions: Sensitivity, specificity and prevalence appropriate to target population
entries.limitations: Not a diagnostic tool by itself; estimates may not transport between populations.

entries.title: Mass balance
entries.units_or_output: quantity per time
entries.meaning: Bookkeeping principle for conserved quantities in a defined system.
entries.epistemic_status: Conservation principle
entries.applicability_conditions: Control volume and all fluxes/reactions defined
entries.limitations: Missing pathways create biased predictions.

entries.title: First-order decay
entries.units_or_output: concentration
entries.meaning: Idealized decay or removal process.
entries.epistemic_status: Simplified kinetic model
entries.applicability_conditions: k ≥ 0; constant first-order rate
entries.limitations: Multiple compartments and nonlinear removal need expanded models.

entries.title: Arithmetic mean
entries.units_or_output: same units as data
entries.meaning: Central summary of numeric observations.
entries.epistemic_status: Definition
entries.applicability_conditions: Finite numeric sample
entries.limitations: Sensitive to extreme values and skew.

entries.title: Sample variance
entries.units_or_output: squared data units
entries.meaning: Unbiased estimator of population variance under standard iid assumptions.
entries.epistemic_status: Estimator
entries.applicability_conditions: n ≥ 2; assumptions matter
entries.limitations: Correlated or weighted observations need different treatment.

entries.title: Root mean squared error
entries.units_or_output: same units as target
entries.meaning: Summarizes prediction error magnitude with stronger penalty on large errors.
entries.epistemic_status: Metric
entries.applicability_conditions: Paired observations on comparable scales
entries.limitations: Does not alone establish scientific validity.

entries.title: Confidence interval
entries.units_or_output: same units as parameter
entries.meaning: A frequentist interval procedure with stated coverage properties.
entries.epistemic_status: Statistical concept
entries.applicability_conditions: Method assumptions and design must be stated
entries.limitations: Not generally the probability that a fixed parameter lies in this particular interval.

entries.title: Floating-point error
entries.formula_or_rule: Computed arithmetic may differ from exact real arithmetic
entries.units_or_output: depends on operation
entries.meaning: Finite precision can cause rounding, cancellation and overflow.
entries.epistemic_status: Numerical computing principle
entries.applicability_conditions: Numeric format and operations specified
entries.limitations: Tolerance should reflect scale, conditioning and purpose.

entries.title: Explicit Euler method
entries.units_or_output: state units
entries.meaning: First-order numerical method for ODE initial-value problems.
entries.epistemic_status: Numerical method
entries.applicability_conditions: Step size h and ODE defined
entries.limitations: Can be inaccurate or unstable; convergence testing is required.

entries.title: Monte Carlo estimation
entries.formula_or_rule: Estimate quantity by sampling from a specified probability model
entries.units_or_output: depends on target
entries.meaning: Uses repeated random samples to estimate expectations or uncertainty.
entries.epistemic_status: Numerical/statistical method
entries.applicability_conditions: Sampling distribution and estimator specified
entries.limitations: Sampling error decreases slowly in many settings; model uncertainty remains.

entries.title: Cross-validation
entries.formula_or_rule: Repeated train/validation splits according to a defined scheme
entries.units_or_output: metric-specific
entries.meaning: Estimates generalization performance under a data-splitting design.
entries.epistemic_status: Evaluation method
entries.applicability_conditions: No leakage; split matches intended deployment
entries.limitations: Random splits may be invalid for temporal, grouped or spatial data.

entries.title: Dimensional consistency
entries.formula_or_rule: Both sides of a physical equation must have matching dimensions
entries.units_or_output: dimension system
entries.meaning: A necessary check for equations involving physical quantities.
entries.epistemic_status: Consistency principle
entries.applicability_conditions: Quantities carry correct dimensions
entries.limitations: Dimensional consistency does not prove an equation is correct.

entries.title: Uncertainty propagation
entries.units_or_output: output variance
entries.meaning: First-order propagation of input covariance through a differentiable function.
entries.epistemic_status: Approximation
entries.applicability_conditions: Small uncertainties and local linearization
entries.limitations: Nonlinear or non-Gaussian cases may require Monte Carlo or other methods.

entries.title: Complex numbers
entries.meaning: Represent numbers with real and imaginary components.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: a,b are real numbers.
entries.limitations: A numerical implementation must define conventions for branches and floating-point errors.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Matrix multiplication
entries.meaning: Combines linear transformations when matrix dimensions are compatible.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Columns of A equal rows of B.
entries.limitations: Matrix multiplication is not generally commutative.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Determinant
entries.meaning: Scalar associated with a square matrix; nonzero determinant indicates invertibility.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: A is square.
entries.limitations: Numerical determinants can be ill-conditioned near singularity.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Eigenvalue equation
entries.meaning: Identifies directions scaled by a linear operator.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: v ≠ 0; A is square.
entries.limitations: Eigenvalues may be complex; numerical results depend on conditioning.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Euclidean norm
entries.meaning: Measures vector magnitude in Euclidean space.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Finite-dimensional real or complex vector.
entries.limitations: Other norms may be more appropriate for a problem.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Taylor expansion
entries.meaning: Approximates a sufficiently smooth function locally.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Required derivatives exist; h is in a useful local range.
entries.limitations: Truncation error may grow rapidly away from the expansion point.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Chain rule
entries.meaning: Differentiates a composition of differentiable functions.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Functions are differentiable at relevant points.
entries.limitations: Multivariable versions require Jacobians and consistent dimensions.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Product rule
entries.meaning: Derivative of a product.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: f and g differentiable.
entries.limitations: Does not replace checking differentiability at boundaries.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Integration by parts
entries.meaning: Transforms an integral into another integral.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Functions satisfy applicable differentiability/integrability conditions.
entries.limitations: A poor choice of u and dv may not simplify the integral.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Gradient
entries.meaning: Points in the direction of steepest local increase under the Euclidean metric.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: f is differentiable.
entries.limitations: Meaning depends on coordinates and metric.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Jacobian matrix
entries.meaning: Describes local linearization of a vector-valued function.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Partial derivatives exist.
entries.limitations: A local linear approximation may be poor for large perturbations.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Hessian matrix
entries.meaning: Describes second-order local curvature.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Second derivatives exist.
entries.limitations: Classification at stationary points may be inconclusive when the Hessian is singular.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Lagrange multipliers
entries.meaning: Finds candidates for constrained extrema.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Constraint regularity conditions apply.
entries.limitations: Necessary conditions do not alone guarantee a global optimum.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Gradient descent
entries.meaning: Iteratively minimizes a differentiable objective.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Step size and gradient are defined.
entries.limitations: Can converge slowly, get stuck at non-global solutions, or diverge with poor step sizes.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Newton method
entries.meaning: Iterative method for solving scalar equations.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Derivative exists and is not zero at the iterate.
entries.limitations: Sensitive to initial conditions and derivative quality.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Bisection method
entries.formula_or_rule: Choose subinterval with sign change repeatedly
entries.meaning: Brackets a root and halves the interval.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Continuous function and a valid sign-changing bracket.
entries.limitations: Finds a bracketed root, not all roots.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Condition number
entries.meaning: Measures sensitivity of a linear solve to perturbations.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: A is invertible for this expression.
entries.limitations: Depends on norm and scaling; high conditioning is not the same as algorithmic instability.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Fourier transform
entries.meaning: Represents a signal in frequency space.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Integrability or a suitable generalized interpretation.
entries.limitations: Conventions differ by normalization and sign.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Convolution
entries.meaning: Combines signals or kernels; appears in linear systems and probability.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Integral exists under suitable conditions.
entries.limitations: Discrete and circular convolutions use different boundary conventions.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Nyquist sampling condition
entries.meaning: Ideal band-limited signal reconstruction requires sampling above twice the maximum frequency.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Signal is band-limited and anti-alias filtering is appropriate.
entries.limitations: Real signals and finite windows need practical margins; it is not a universal guarantee.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Partial differential equation
entries.meaning: Models fields varying over space and/or time.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Domain, boundary conditions and well-posedness must be specified.
entries.limitations: A numerical solver cannot repair invalid assumptions or missing boundary data.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Linear stability of a fixed point
entries.formula_or_rule: Eigenvalues of the Jacobian determine local linear stability
entries.meaning: Uses local dynamics near an equilibrium.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Smooth dynamical system and equilibrium identified.
entries.limitations: Nonlinear behavior beyond the local neighborhood may differ.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Dimensional analysis
entries.formula_or_rule: Physically valid equations must be dimensionally consistent
entries.meaning: Checks compatibility of units and can reduce parameters.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: All quantities have correctly assigned dimensions.
entries.limitations: Dimensional consistency is necessary, not sufficient, for correctness.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Conservation law
entries.formula_or_rule: dQ/dt = 0 for a closed isolated system
entries.meaning: A conserved quantity remains constant under specified assumptions.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: System boundary and isolation assumptions are explicit.
entries.limitations: Open systems require flux/source terms.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Standard deviation
entries.meaning: Expresses dispersion in the original units.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Variance is defined.
entries.limitations: Does not describe all distribution shapes.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Standard error of mean
entries.meaning: Quantifies estimated sampling variability of the sample mean.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Independent observations and suitable sampling assumptions.
entries.limitations: Not the same as standard deviation or an individual prediction interval.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: P-value
entries.formula_or_rule: P(test statistic at least as extreme | null hypothesis)
entries.meaning: Measures compatibility of data with a specified null model.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Test and null hypothesis are defined in advance.
entries.limitations: Not the probability that the null hypothesis is true; affected by multiplicity and design.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Bayes theorem
entries.meaning: Updates a hypothesis probability using data and a likelihood model.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: P(D) > 0 and probabilities are coherent.
entries.limitations: Depends on the model and prior; posterior is not automatically causal.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Likelihood
entries.meaning: Scores parameter values by the probability of observed data under a model.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: A sampling model is specified.
entries.limitations: Likelihood values are not themselves parameter probabilities.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Maximum likelihood estimation
entries.meaning: Chooses parameters maximizing likelihood.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Optimization problem is well-defined.
entries.limitations: May have multiple maxima, boundary solutions or small-sample bias.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Ordinary least squares
entries.meaning: Fits a linear predictor by minimizing squared residuals.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Design matrix and outcomes are defined.
entries.limitations: Inference needs additional assumptions; outliers can dominate.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Pearson correlation
entries.meaning: Measures linear association between variables.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Nonzero variances and paired observations.
entries.limitations: Correlation does not establish causation and can miss nonlinear association.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Spearman rank correlation
entries.meaning: Measures monotonic rank association.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Paired observations with rank handling defined.
entries.limitations: Ties and small samples affect inference.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Bootstrap resampling
entries.meaning: Approximates sampling uncertainty using repeated resampling.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Resampling scheme reflects the sampling design.
entries.limitations: Naive resampling fails for dependent data or unrepresentative samples.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Permutation test
entries.formula_or_rule: Compare observed statistic to label/assignment permutations
entries.meaning: Builds a null distribution under exchangeability assumptions.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Valid permutation scheme and exchangeability.
entries.limitations: Permutations cannot fix confounding or biased sampling.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Statistical power
entries.meaning: Probability a test rejects the null under a specified alternative.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Effect size, sample size, variance, alpha and test are specified.
entries.limitations: Power is scenario-specific and depends on assumptions.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Multiple-testing correction
entries.formula_or_rule: Control family-wise error or false discovery rate
entries.meaning: Adjusts interpretation when many hypotheses are tested.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Testing family and chosen error criterion are defined.
entries.limitations: Different procedures trade power and error control differently.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Missing-data mechanisms
entries.meaning: Distinguishes mechanisms that affect missing-data handling.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Mechanism assumptions are assessed.
entries.limitations: Mechanisms are often not identifiable from observed data alone.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Cross-validation
entries.formula_or_rule: Train on folds; evaluate on held-out folds
entries.meaning: Estimates out-of-sample predictive performance.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Splits respect groups, time and data dependencies.
entries.limitations: Data leakage produces overly optimistic estimates.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: ROC AUC
entries.formula_or_rule: Area under true-positive-rate vs false-positive-rate curve
entries.meaning: Measures ranking discrimination across thresholds.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Binary outcomes and scores are defined.
entries.limitations: Does not assess calibration or decision utility; prevalence matters for related metrics.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Probability calibration
entries.formula_or_rule: Predicted probabilities should match observed frequencies
entries.meaning: Checks reliability of probabilistic predictions.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Sufficient representative evaluation data.
entries.limitations: Good calibration does not imply good discrimination or causal validity.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Kinetic energy
entries.meaning: Translational kinetic energy in the nonrelativistic regime.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Point mass or center-of-mass translational motion; v ≪ c.
entries.limitations: Rotational/internal energy may need additional terms.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Near-Earth gravitational potential energy
entries.meaning: Approximate gravitational energy change near Earth's surface.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Nearly constant gravitational acceleration.
entries.limitations: Large altitude changes need gravitational potential model.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Linear momentum
entries.meaning: Mass times velocity in classical mechanics.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Nonrelativistic regime.
entries.limitations: Relativistic momentum differs.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Mechanical work
entries.meaning: Energy transferred by a force along a path.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Force and path are defined.
entries.limitations: Nonconservative forces may require path-dependent treatment.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: Power
entries.meaning: Rate of energy transfer.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
entries.applicability_conditions: Differentiable work/energy history.
entries.limitations: Instantaneous and average power differ.
entries.epistemic_status: Foundational relationship or established model class; application-specific verification required

entries.title: First law of thermodynamics
entries.formula_or_rule: ΔU = Q − W (work done by system convention)
entries.meaning: Energy conservation for thermodynamic systems.
entries.units_or_output: See variable definitions and unit conventions for the application.
